title: Walrus artwork on Epstein's wall

tellings.quote:
And on the wall there was a big artwork
of a a woman being raped by a walrus.

plain: In 2002, a large artwork showing a woman being raped by a walrus hung on a wall at one of Jeffrey Epstein's properties. Epstein was a wealthy financier. The story comes from Jay Anderson, who passes on what he was told by a witness named Juliet Byron, and he tells it as a glimpse of the dark world around Epstein.
